name: Sith dagger
description: A Sith dagger or Sith blade was type of blade that resonated with the power of the dark side of the Force was wielded by Sith assassins. The assassin Ochi of Bestoon utilized one such blade.

data.name: Sith dagger
purpose: Inflict agony by draining the blood of living beings
Lead the wielder to Sith temples and forgotten treasures
